Same bill-saving copy as the 16 Oct ad (Save Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 20,000+ per month, 10+ years across Telangana & Andhra Pradesh, free expert site survey, call 73373 37677) running with a new creative - the newest ad in the set.

ad_library.summary: Krisol Solar is running 3 active Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram), all started between 16 and 21 October 2026. Two offer angles are live: the stacked Rs. 78,000 government subsidy + Rs. 22,000 Krisol discount, and the Rs. 3,000-20,000 monthly bill-saving story. Every ad's click lands on an fb.me link inside Facebook, so none of the spend reaches krisolsolar.com. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not krisolsolar.com. You own no pixel on the landing experience, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not enquire, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on.

findings: All 3 live ads point to fb.me links inside Facebook - the click never lands on krisolsolar.com, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

Your own site already has the pieces the ads need: a contact form, a 'Government Subsidy Available' popup form (name, phone, city, email, message), an FAQ that explains the Rs. 78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and a services carousel (rooftops, water heaters, street lights, pumps). None of the paid traffic ever sees any of it.
The contact page lists krisolsolarinfra@gmail.com while the site footer publishes sales@krisolsolar.com - two inboxes for the same enquiry, so leads can land where nobody is watching.
3 ads, all launched within 5 days (16-21 Oct), all cold traffic. There is no second creative angle and no retargeting ad behind them yet.
The 'Save Rs. 1 Lakh' stacked-offer ad is your sharpest hook and it is only 5 days old - the measurement to know which of the two angles works does not exist while the clicks stay inside Facebook.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Point all 3 ads at a dedicated Kompally landing page carrying the same Rs. 78,000 + Rs. 22,000 offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not enquire - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Publish sales@krisolsolar.com everywhere (ads, forms, footer) and retire or forward the Gmail address so an enquiry can never sit unread.
Give the bill-saving angle somewhere to land
The Rs. 3,000-20,000/month story deserves a savings calculator or before/after bill section on the landing page - it is the ad's whole promise and today it dead-ends at fb.me.
